title: Taking Shape
body:
Something is taking shape in the lab. A few familiar objects are starting to appear, though the path from one to the next is still being worked out.

For now, this is just a glimpse.

![A Geometry Authoring Lab catalog showing three stages of a brass tuba, followed by a teal rotary phone, coral desk fan, and blue bench vise on labeled pedestals.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-07-15-from-primitives-to-polished-props/cpu-catalog-overview.png)

![Four brass tuba iterations on dark plinths, progressing from simple primitive construction to swept tubing, added valves, and a more connected final assembly.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-07-15-from-primitives-to-polished-props/tuba-iteration.png)
